notes.title: Small update
notes.content: -Details on Sutelz's face have been improved.

notes.title: Big Update
notes.content:
-Bugs fixed.
-Added dialogues to Hioces in her robotic state.
-Added more audios of Orion singing on the island map.
-Save point: The Cat on the large map near the amusement park is now placed at the start of the path for easier gameplay. (Previously, it was at the edge.)
-The protagonist’s (Sutelz Selz) appearance has been updated. Previously, her physical changes were not very noticeable, but now it is clear that she is 17-19 years old.
-New expressions added.
-2 variables with different angles for Sutelz: the first for when she interacts with anyone, and the second variable ONLY for when interacting with Henry.
-Now, touching the cave event and hospital door automatically transitions to the map, further simplifying gameplay.
-Some dialogues in Portuguese on the roller coaster were improved to better align with the character’s thought process.
-Japanese script improved (dialogues in the Japanese translation).
-Fixed wording errors in the Japanese translation.
-Corrected formatting issues in the Japanese translation.
-Fixed naming errors in the Japanese translation.
-Corrected translation mistakes in English (the character "Bear" was named in another language).
-The translator only worked on the script (dialogues). The English translation mistake was my oversight, as I did not notice that some parts were still in Portuguese in the English version. I have not received complaints, but I apologize for this.

Brief Description:
This game takes place during the time when the half-Heflite, half-human girl, Sutelz Selz, is 17-19 years old, showcasing the main events and moments that shaped her life.

Friendship, confrontation, freedom, learning, and profound emotions...

Discover now what her journey was like by experiencing and controlling everything the Heflitian Girl went through...

Note: These update changes also apply to the DEMO version.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012810/Kimi_sae_Ireba_Episode_Sutelz/

notes.title: Voices, Money, and Quit Button Update!
notes.content:
Exciting Updates in If Only You Were Here - Chapter Sutelz! 🎮✨

1️⃣ Voices when using items 🎙️
Characters now come to life with unique voices every time an item is used!

2️⃣ Money Display 💰
Manage your resources more easily by checking your balance directly on the screen.

3️⃣ Quit Button for the cave 🏞️
Changed your mind or need to leave the cave? A new quit button lets you return to the last safe area effortlessly.

4️⃣ Stronger enemies and worse 🦹🏻
Hef-Robot is hitting harder than before.

5️⃣Full HP!🧬
Eating the Hot Dog restores HP to 100%.

These updates bring more control and immersion to your adventure in Sutelz!

🛠️ Update now and enjoy the new features!


Warning: These changes do not apply to the demo version.
